content:
name: Temporary program hierarchy projection refresh

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - planning/program-hierarchy-reconciliation

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  refresh:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: planning/program-hierarchy-reconciliation
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Remove one-shot workflow from final tree
        run: git rm .github/workflows/tmp-program-hierarchy-refresh.yml

      - name: Refresh deterministic projections
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write

      - name: Verify refreshed projections
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          python3 scripts/generate-mvp-work-packets.py --check
          python3 scripts/populate-artifact-system.py --check

      - name: Commit refreshed projections
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No projection refresh changes were required."
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "chore: refresh generated planning projections"
          git push origin HEAD:planning/program-hierarchy-reconciliation
